titles.title: CANADA FIRE Act
CANADA FIRE Act
Countering Atmospheric Nuisances Arising from Drifting Airborne Foreign Incendiary Residual Emissions Act
To impose sanctions with respect to the Government of Canada in response to transboundary wildfire smoke affecting the United States, and for other purposes.
